documents.title: Doc 37 - INFRINGEMENT - Car 4 - Causing a collision
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 4 - Causing a collision

details.fact: Car 4 (Stromsted) had a collision with Car 29 (Lacorte) heading towards Turn 12.
details.infringement: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 (d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
details.decision: Ten second (10) time penalty in accordance with Article 39.3 (b) of the FIA F3 Sporting Regulations. In addition, 2 penalty points to be added to the driver’s record. Total for the 2026 season = 2 penalty points.
details.reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence. Car 29 (LAC) established a slight overlap on the inside with Car 4 (STR) heading towards Turn 12. STR defended by moving toward the inside but did not leave sufficient racing room for LAC on track. A collision occurred between the cars. The Stewards determine that STR was wholly responsible for the collision and elect to apply the standard penalty.

documents.title: Doc 36 - INFRINGEMENT - Car 29 - Did not engage start set up procedure (formation lap)
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 29 - Did not engage start set up procedure (formation lap)

details.fact: Car 29 (Lacorte) did not have the start set-up procedure activated when leaving the grid to start the formation lap.
details.infringement: Breach of Article 37.6 of the FIA Formula 3 Sporting Regulations.
details.decision: Ten second time penalty in accordance with Article 39.3 (b) of the FIA Formula 3 Sporting Regulations. No driver penalty points are associated with this penalty.
details.reason: The Stewards summoned the driver and team representative (Document 33) and heard the driver, team representative and Technical Delegate. The Technical Delegate provided ECU data from Car 29 that confirmed that the Start set-up procedure was not activated when LAC left the grid to start the formation lap. The team accepted the accuracy of the data. LAC stated that he believed that he had activated the Start set-up procedure, but after moving off discovered that it had not been activated. Having considered the matter extensively, the Stewards determined that LAC was in breach of Article 37.6 of the FIA Formula 3 Sporting Regulations. A 10 second time penalty is applied in accordance with the 2026 FIA F3 penalty guidelines.

details.fact: Car 29 (Lacorte) moved before the start signal - false start.
details.infringement: Breach of Article 37.15 of the FIA Formula 3 Sporting Regulations.
details.decision: Five (5) second time penalty in accordance with Article 39.3 a) of the FIA Formula 3 Sporting Regulations. No driver penalty points are associated with this infringement.
details.reason: The Stewards examined video evidence and telemetry data. Having considered the matter extensively, the Stewards determined that the driver of Car 29 (LAC) moved slightly after the third light and before the start signal was given. The Stewards note that the movement was minimal. Accordingly, the Stewards impose the least of the penalties available to them.

documents.title: Doc 28 - INFRIGEMENT - Car 20 - Causing a collision
documents.subject: INFRIGEMENT - Car 20 - Causing a collision

details.fact: Car 20 (Sharp) collided with Car 21 (Wharton) at Turn 5.
details.infringement: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 (d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
details.decision: Ten second (10) time penalty in accordance with Article 39.3 (b) of the FIA F3 Sporting Regulations. In addition, 2 points to be added to the driver’s record. Total for the 2026 season = 2 points.
details.reason: The stewards examined video and telemetry evidence. Having considered the matter extensively, the stewards determine Cars 20 (SHA) and 21 (WHA) had been racing hard since Turn 1 with WHA leading. They got side by side in Turn 3 and SHA attempted an outside pass on (WHA) at Turn 4. SHA was not ahead at the apex and had not earned the right to be given room on the exit. WHA properly made a full exit which caused SHA to exceed track limits on the exit. The stewards accept that SHA could not simply disappear even though he was obliged to concede the corner. At this point, SHA was required to rejoin safely and without gaining a lasting advantage. Telemetry indicated that SHA maintained full throttle in the runoff area which put him in position to set up for an inside pass at Turn 5. Being in position to attack, when he should have properly conceded, constituted an advantage to which SHA was not entitled. WHA turned into Turn 5 and collided with SHA who was midway alongside. Regardless of the question of gaining an advantage, SHA had not established sufficient position to have gained the right to racing room on the inside. The stewards determine that SHA is wholly responsible for the collision and elect to apply the standard penalty.

documents.title: Doc 26 - DECISION - End of race matters - Race 1 (Sprint)
documents.subject: DECISION - End of race matters - Race 1 (Sprint)

details.fact: :           After a red flag, the Race Director determined that the window in the schedule expired without the possibility to resume the race
details.decision: :       Under the Authority of the Stewards contained in ISC Article 11.7.3.r, the Stewards decide to stop permanently Race 1. Points for the race will be awarded in accordance with Article 6.5 of the 2025 FIA F3 Regulations
details.reason: :         During the Sprint Race, the red flag was displayed on Lap 9. The Stewards were advised by the Race Director that the race could not be resumed due to the repairs required to the trackside barrier. The Race Director also confirmed that no adjustments to the event schedule could be made to allow the race to resume. In light of this, the Stewards elect to permanently stop the race. Accordingly, points for the race will be awarded in accordance with Article 6.5 of the 2026 FIA Formula 3 Sporting Regulations.
